text: No, the forest on this property is not being cleared today. The most recent observed clearing occurred in 2021, when 81.3 hectares of planted pine forest were lost. This event was confirmed by multiple sources, including the University of Maryland’s Global Forest Change dataset and the European Commission’s Joint Research Centre 2020 reference. Since then, no further clearing has been detected in the latest available data (2025). The 2021 loss was primarily small patches of planted forest, not native forest. No additional clearing events meet the detection criteria after 2021.
